Mathematical processing and adjustment of the obtained satellite vectors were performed in the CREDO DAT software package. The coordinates of the points of the "Arychny" and "Temny Bereg" geodetic network in the conditional coordinate system of TOO "PCOP" and the Balticheightsystemwere usedas theinitial values. The root mean square error (RMSE) of the planimetric position of the survey network points was no more than ±4 mm, and the vertical position was no more than ±5 mm, which fully meets the strict tolerances of SP RK 1.02-101-2014.
